[P2] Resolve invoke failures that have no synthesized cause

For an invoke checkpoint containing `{ ErrorType: "PaymentError", ErrorMessage: "" }`, the SDK throws `InvokeError("Invoke failed")` without a cause, both live and on replay. This guard bypasses the fallback lookup, although the failed `CHAINED_INVOKE` operation retains `PaymentError`. Consequently, the operation reports `PaymentError` while the execution reports `InvokeError`. Include cause-less invoke errors in the fallback, account for the default message when matching empty or missing checkpoint messages, and add live/replay coverage.
